description.text:
The Storming Emergence GX Starter Deck (起始卡组 横空出世GX) was the ready-to-play product of the first Simplified Chinese release, on sale in mainland China from 28 October 2022 alongside the Radiant (赫), Verdant (苍) and Abundant (泽) booster packs. Each box held a deck built and ready to play. Like the boosters, its cards were chosen from the existing cards of the Sun & Moon series.

Its cards are numbered out of 324. Twelve holo cards are numbered past that, 325 to 336: full-art Raichu GX, Alolan Ninetales GX, Diantha, Underground Expedition, Wicke and Morty, rainbow Raichu GX and Alolan Ninetales GX, and gold Switch Raft, Crushing Hammer, Super Scoop Up and Rotom Dex.
